{

  "viewport": { "width": 1920, "height": 1080 },
  "cases": [
    {
      "name": "left click",
      "response": "<think>I need to open a terminal where I can run a git clone command.</think>
<action>Click the terminal icon in the left sidebar to open a terminal.</action>
<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>
left_click
</parameter>
<parameter=coordinate>
[19, 561]
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>",
      "expectedAction": "left_click"
    },
    {
      "name": "type",
      "response": "<think>The Activities overview is now open with a search bar at the top.</think>
<action>Type "terminal" into the search bar to find the Terminal application.</action>
<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>
type
</parameter>
<parameter=text>
terminal
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>",
      "expectedAction": "type"
    },
    {
      "name": "wait",
      "response": "<think>The git clone command is now running successfully.</think>
<action>Wait for the git clone operation to complete.</action>
<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>
wait
</parameter>
<parameter=time>
0.5
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>",
      "expectedControl": "WAIT"
    },
    {
      "name": "finished",
      "response": "<think>The git clone operation has completed successfully.</think>
<action>The repository has been successfully cloned to `/home/user/instructor-embedding`. The task is complete.</action>
<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>
finished
</parameter>
<parameter=status>
success
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>",
      "expectedControl": "DONE"
    }
  ]
}
